title: Wizard's Arcane Study
description: A purple-skinned tiefling wizard with large curved horns stands behind a long ornate desk, casting a glowing blue spell from an open book. The room is filled with magical items, potion bottles, scrolls, a large crystal chandelier, framed paintings of cosmic scenes on the walls, and a foreground table with gold coins, a crystal ball, and an open spellbook.
prompt: A detailed fantasy scene inside a wizard's study with a purple-skinned tiefling sorcerer with large horns wearing purple robes standing at a long white desk covered in scrolls, glowing potions, and open books. He is casting a spell with blue magical energy. Crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling, walls are decorated with framed cosmic paintings, an arched doorway leads to a starry night. Foreground table displays gold coins, a red arcane seal, crystal ball, and another open spellbook. Mystical atmosphere with floating magical particles.
